'''Krel''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] who was working for the [[Migrant Merchants' Guild]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="War Droids" /> during the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> A [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]], Krel designed [[Battle droid/Legends|war droids]] within his [[Krel's cybernetics laboratory|laboratory]] for the criminal organization and claimed to have created cyborg sleeper agents from civilians that had been captured by the Guild. The [[Republic Special Forces Division]] unit known as [[Havoc Squad]] [[Death/Legends|killed]] the cyborg under the orders of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Elin Garza|Garza]].<ref name="War Droids" /> Investigation after his death revealed that he was unsuccessful in creating any of the cyborg sleeper agents.<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' Mail: “FW: After-action Report: Migrant Merchants' Guild” received after completion of “Destroying the War Droids.”</ref>
